title: stackra.lock.yaml
description: The pinned revision of every external producer manifest this workspace builds clients from (ADR 0158, ADR 0260). Producer to revision only: no secret and no URL. A producer in this repository is not listed.

producers.description: Producer module key → the git revision of its committed `.stackra/app-manifest.json`.

additionalProperties.description: Git commit SHA (7 to 40 hex characters).
